name: drupal/photos_sh
description: Photos.sh image effects for Drupal image styles: remove backgrounds, upscale, remove text, fix photos for marketplaces, fix light and colour, remove noise, colourise, restore or hide faces, crop, expand, watermark.

suggest.drupal/imagemagick: Run the effects with the ImageMagick toolkit instead of GD.
suggest.drupal/key: Keep the API key in a Key module key instead of configuration.
